## About the Institution

SKILL BHARAT EDUCATION is a private online vocational learning and student services platform focused on practical skills, technical education and career-oriented learning.

The platform provides vocational learning resources, student registration, online admission applications, student dashboard facilities and certificate-related services.

## Courses and Learning Areas

1. Electrician
   Electrical fundamentals, electrical safety, wiring basics, circuits and tools.

2. AC Technician
   Air conditioning fundamentals, refrigeration systems, maintenance and safety.

3. Computer / IT
   Computer fundamentals, operating systems, networking and basic IT skills.

4. Mobile Repairing
   Mobile hardware, components, troubleshooting and repair fundamentals.

5. General Trade
   Workshop safety, hand tools, measuring tools and practical skills.

6. Plumber / Plumbing
   Pipes, fittings, water supply, drainage and plumbing fundamentals.

## Student Services

- Student Registration
- Student Login
- Online Admission
- Student Dashboard
- Student Profile
- Learning Materials
- Certificate Application
- Certificate ID Verification
- Certificate PDF Download (subject to approval)

## Admission

Students can visit the official website to explore available courses and submit online admission applications.

Admission requirements and course availability are subject to the information published on the official website.

## Certificate Verification

Certificate applications are subject to administrator review.

Certificate status can be checked through the official Certificate Verification facility using the Certificate ID.

Do not assume that an application or certificate request has been approved without checking its actual status.
